credits.title: Udta Teer
credits.overview: An amnesiac Pakistani spy wakes up believing he is a patriotic Indian counter-terrorism officer.

credits.title: Bhooth Bangla
credits.overview: A man inherits a palace in rural Mangalpur and plans his sister's wedding there, but strange supernatural events and panicked locals force him to investigate the property's mysterious past.

credits.title: Bhool Bhulaiyaa 3
credits.overview: Rooh Baba ventures into a haunted mansion in the kingdom of Raktaghat in West Bengal, where he confronts two vengeful spirits, both asserting to be Manjulika.

credits.title: Thank God
credits.overview: An egoistic real estate broker in huge debts, meets with an accident. As he gains consciousness, he realizes that he is in heaven. God appears before him and informs him that he must play a 'Game of Life'. If he manages to win, he will be sent back to earth; if he loses, he will be sent to hell.

credits.title: Bhool Bhulaiyaa 2
credits.overview: When strangers Reet and Ruhan cross paths, their journey leads to an abandoned mansion and a dreaded spirit who has been trapped for eighteen years.

credits.title: Housefull 4
credits.overview: Three couples who get separated from each other due to an evil ploy, reincarnate after 600 years and meet each other as history repeats itself again and their respective partners get mixed up this time.

credits.title: A Flying Jatt
credits.overview: Jatt is a reluctant superhero that fights crime and protects people. He meets his match in the evil Raka who he must face off to save the day.

credits.title: Great Grand Masti
credits.overview: Amar, Meet and Prem go into a small town where they encounter a 'femme fatale' in the form of Ragini. Ragini is everything they had dreamed of, but she slowly turns into their worst nightmare!
